messages:
anya: Quick cut decision 0m: MVP freeze Fri. Two blockers: embeddings cache causing OOMs in long soaks; legal wants more review on multi-tenant SSO. My default: MUST: core gen API, single-tenant SSO, telemetry & rollout hooks. MAY: emb cache only if infra gives a validated 48h soak. CUT: tenant routing + advanced admin to v1 unless we ship a demo shim.

rio: Agree with default. Emb cache in MVP only if infra certifies soak. Otherwise cut to v1 and commit a landing window.

sam: Demo risk: removing tenant routing breaks the ACME demo. I can ship a 10screen demo shim (fake tenant selector + read-only data) in ~2 dev days to keep sales demos working.

maria: Data note: without emb cache we see ~18% p95 regression on recommend flows and ~3% CTR dip in perf runs. If deferred, create baseline perf ticket and flag instrumentation for later lift measurement.

infra-bot: infra: OOM root cause likely KV eviction tuning + quant change. Hotfix ETA: 4 dev days + 2 validation days. Can attempt a 48h mitigation spike (2d) but not guaranteed.

anya: Decision rule: if infra posts validated 48h soak by Wed EOD -> path A: dark-launch emb cache at 1% with strict canary (p95 <300ms, error-rate delta <0.5%, cost delta <1.5x) and rollback ready. Else -> path B: cut emb cache to v1 + ship demo shim.

rio: If path B, add emb cache to v1 milestone and assign infra+product owners. Also notify sales.

sam: I'll start the demo shim spike and post an estimate by EOD today.

maria: I'll create perf tickets: `perf/embcache/baseline` and `perf/embcache/post-enable` and add feature flags: `feature.embcache`, `exp.embcache.cohort`.

anya: Action items: (1) infra to confirm soak/ETA, (2) sam spike demo shim, (3) maria perf tickets, (4) rio update roadmap & comms. Reconvene Thu 10:00 for final call.

deploy-bot: milestone:Q2-MVP readiness updated by anya status: "cutlist-awaiting-infra"
